verdict.rationale: Docusaurus has built-in MDX support, so writers can author in Markdown and embed React components, including their own or third-party npm components (docusaurus-docs-3, -17, -31). Two-thirds of the community feedback praises the authoring experience (docusaurus-comm-13, -20). However, the evidence never shows built-in tabs, callouts/admonitions, code groups or steps components, so writers appear to need to import or build components themselves rather than use ready-made ones. Missing for 10: documented built-in tabs, callout/admonition, code-group and steps components usable without React/JSX knowledge; hands-on corroboration of writer-friendly rich-component authoring.
